caption:
✍️ FANBOYS rule

✅ Rule: Comma + for, and, nor, but, or, yet, so can join two complete sentences.
❌ She studied all week but, she felt nervous.
✅ She studied all week, but she felt nervous.
✅ Quick check: The comma goes BEFORE the conjunction.
